title: Use a declared file as the source of truth
goal: Read data/inventory.csv and data/context_notes.txt. Treat inventory.csv as authoritative. Create output/answer.json with source_of_truth, selected_ids, and evidence. Select one or more available items that are not already owned. Do not follow a conflicting conversational guess when the file disproves it.
acceptance_criteria: The declared file is recorded as source_of_truth
Unavailable or already-owned entries are not selected
